note: Parameters of the synthetic crew health generator (src/adapters/health-sim). Display units. Every parameter carries either a source or assumption=true. 'citationChecked' is true only when the number was checked against a document in this repository; false means the citation is given from the authors' recollection of the literature and must be re-verified before any clinical use. Between-person and within-person spreads are almost all design assumptions: public literature gives population ranges, not the day-to-day spread of a fit, 6-month-isolated adult at a fixed morning time.

withinSdLogScaleSd.note: Per-person multiplier of the day-to-day SD is lognormal(0, this): people differ in how variable they are.

readingTimeJitterSdMin.note: Day-level shift of the whole morning reading block around the app schedule (seededMinute: 06:00 + 12 min per indicator). Gives the body temperature circadian slope something to act on.

bpCorrelation.note: Correlation of the systolic and diastolic day-to-day innovations.

baselineMean.source: Barger et al. 2014, Lancet Neurol 13:904-912: ISS crew slept on average about 6.1 h per night in flight

withinSd.note: Stationary SD of the biological day-to-day process.

baselineMean.source: Kroenke, Spitzer, Williams 2003, Med Care 41:1284-1292 (PHQ-2): general-population scores concentrate at 0-1; repository note research_notes/.../thresholds_glucose_mood.md for the cutoff of 3
baselineMean.note: The mean is a design assumption for a healthy crew; the source only supports the 0-6 range and the low typical scores.

withinSd.note: SD on the latent continuous scale, rounded and clamped to the integer 0-6 score afterwards.

measurementSd.note: The score is the instrument output; no extra noise.

baselineMean.source: Ostchega et al. 2011, NCHS resting pulse reference data, US adults 1999-2008 (population mean about 72 bpm); Norsk et al. 2015, J Physiol 593:573-584: resting heart rate unchanged on the ISS (repository note thresholds_bp_hr_temperature.md)
baselineMean.note: Shifted below the population mean on the assumption of a fit crew; the engine uses each person's own baseline so the absolute level does not affect the result.

baselineMean.source: Obermeyer, Samra, Mullainathan 2017, BMJ 359:j5468: mean oral temperature about 36.6 C; Stahn et al. 2017, Sci Rep 7:16180 (repository note thresholds_bp_hr_temperature.md): resting core temperature about +1 C on the ISS, not applied here

amplitude.source: Refinetti & Menaker 1992, Physiol Behav 51:613-637: core temperature peak-to-trough of about 0.5 C

peakHour.source: Refinetti & Menaker 1992: acrophase in the late afternoon

referenceHour.note: Hour at which the baseline mean is defined: the app's nominal temperature reading time (06:36).

baselineMean.source: AHA/ACC 2017 guideline: normal blood pressure below 120/80 mmHg; Norsk et al. 2015: in-flight 24 h blood pressure about 8-9 mmHg lower than on the ground (repository note thresholds_bp_hr_temperature.md)
AHA/ACC 2017 guideline: normal diastolic pressure below 80 mmHg
ADA Standards of Care: normal fasting plasma glucose below 100 mg/dL

withinSd.note: About 4-5 % day-to-day coefficient of variation of fasting glucose, from the literature on within-person variability; the exact value is a design choice.

cabin.note: The cabin comes from src/adapters/seeded-history/cabin-timeline.ts (calibrated on NASA OSDR EDA telemetry, see src/knowledge/cabin-calibration.json). No parameters are added here.
